name: When is the best time to buy a pre-construction condo?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to buy a pre-construction condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to buy a pre-construction condo often depends on your investment goals and market conditions. Early entry during the 'friends and family' or 'VIP' phases can offer the best pricing and selection of units. However, purchasing closer to completion might provide more certainty regarding the final product and delivery timeline. Kelby Contreras can offer guidance on current market trends in areas like Aventura or Brickell, helping you determine if an early purchase or a later stage entry aligns with your objectives.
acceptedAnswer.description: Early phases often offer better pricing and selection, while later stages provide more certainty. Your investment goals and market conditions influence the best timing.
